text:
sophia: PTAL on PR #4321 — I've addressed the comments from yesterday. Switched to a static shard count to avoid the race in allocator rotation, added unit tests for kv allocation, and moved the flaky scenario behind a feature flag for now. CI is red due to an e2e timeout (integration.test_dispatch). I disabled the single flaky case temporarily in the e2e run, but would prefer not to merge with disabled tests. Can we get quick eyes + decide on a canary window tonight? Link: https://repo/pull/4321

alex: looking now. quick question — can you paste the small config snippet you changed for shard count? want to double-check compatibility with the autoscaler logic.

sophia: sure, pasted below:
```yaml
serving:
  shard_count: 4  # moved from dynamic -> static to avoid rotation race
  autoscale: enabled
  autoscale_min: 2
```
this is only for the dedicated path; hosted still uses dynamic.

raj: skimmed the diff. overall looks good, added two nits inline (naming + log message). major +1 from me assuming the e2e failure is unrelated. also: please open a ticket for the temporarily disabled test so we don't lose it.

ci-bot: CI status: 
- circleci/build: failed — integration.test_dispatch timed out (exit 1)
- rerun suggested: `circleci retry`

jen: I can schedule a canary slot tonight at 21:00 PT if we want. do we need 30m or 60m? my vote 30m plus rollback watch. @alex @raj

sophia: thanks. I re-ran CI after a small backoff tweak (retry sleep increase) — pushed a tiny fix in the same branch. PTAL @alex @raj. If green, 30m canary at 21:00 PT works for me. I filed the test ticket: #987 (link: https://issues/987).

alex: left one nit about the log wording, otherwise lgtm. please squash the small fix commit and re-run CI. after green, schedule canary and merge during the 21:00 slot.

raj: :thumbsup: I'll watch the canary and verify latency + error rate for the shard path. filing a follow-up for observability dashboard tweak.

sophia: thanks all — I'll squash, re-run CI now and ping back once green. PTAL again after CI pass. :rocket:
